title: 脑细胞数据中心：生物芯片新方案
titleEn: Brain Cells Power Prototype Data Centre
summary: 新加坡国立大学研究人员开发生物数据中心原型，用脑细胞代替电脑芯片，有望提升能效。
summaryEn: Researchers at the National University of Singapore developed a prototype biological data centre powered by brain cells instead of computer chips, with potential for improved energy efficiency.
speaker: CNA
